note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 (independent judge, clean clone at c8584247bb) after 14d83a90bd changed applyConfig. Section 5.2 step 3b: "(No SAs are created in response to receipt of a packet that requires IPsec protection; only BYPASS or DISCARD cache entries can be created this way.) If there is no match, discard the traffic." Same producer walk as RFC4301-5.2-1. The only change to applyConfig in 14d83a90bd is one statement: s.reloadPool(cfg.RemoteAccess) became s.table.virtualIP.reload(cfg.RemoteAccess, s.log) (virtual_ip.go). reload builds named eap.Pool descriptors and stores them in an atomic pointer; it touches no dataplane, installs and removes no SPD entry, and returns nothing, so it cannot refuse the apply. It still runs after installUnmatched, installIKEBypass, installSPDPolicies and setCookieThreshold, so the catch-all remains the first entry in on every apply. releaseSPD, shutdown, warnSPDLeft, installUnmatched and the other cited producers are unchanged. The virtual-IP work (a965d7c0d4) also substitutes the lease into the Child SA selector before the policy match (ts_narrow.go substituteVirtualIP); those Child SA policies are installed inside the engine window, above the catch-all, through the existing Child SA install path and its ledger. The unmatched-traffic paths are unchanged: VPP runs only under `unmatched bypass` with no catch-all (vppPolicyInterface, ErrNoNodeWideSPD), and the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries (defaultDataplaneSource) have no catch-all, so traffic matching no entry there is delivered, not discarded. Named tests pass at HEAD under -race (TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry, TestRunInstallsNoSPDEntryBeforeTheFirstApply, TestUnmatched*). Gap stands; {gap} annotation accurate.
